open_close_internal_detail_focus_return.methodology_note: [INFERENCE/tooling caveat, not a site defect] The first two attempts to click the detail button via agent-browser's `click` command silently no-op'd because the target was far below the fold on this long single-page layout and the CLI did not auto-scroll it into the visual viewport (elementFromPoint at the button's reported coordinates returned null, i.e. outside the rendered viewport at scrollY=0). Running `scrollintoview` immediately before `click` fixed this, and a direct native `.click()` via eval also opened the dialog instantly — proving the site's click handler itself works correctly and this was purely an agent-browser scroll-timing quirk, not a production bug.

benign_canceled_same_origin_requests_dis: GET /assets/family-outing-mobile.webp (requestId 306.36) — no status recorded, occurred while the page was at the 1440px desktop viewport. This is the <picture>/responsive-image candidate NOT selected by the browser for that viewport (desktop chose family-outing.webp, 200 OK, instead). Not a failure.

GET /assets/family-outing.webp (requestId 306.110) — no status recorded, occurred during the 360px mobile reload. This is the complementary unselected <picture> candidate for that viewport (mobile chose family-outing-mobile.webp, confirmed 200 then 304-cached). Not a failure.
console_and_network_errors.explanation: Both 'no status' entries are standard browser <picture>-element candidate preloading/cancellation (the browser speculatively starts a request for an alternate responsive-image source, then abandons it once media-query resolution picks the other source). Same-origin, zero rendering impact, and in each case the selected sibling image loaded successfully with 200/304. These were correctly excluded from the error count.
